Use case: identity-preserve costume repair. Create ONE complete independent full-body neutral costume anchor for the EXISTING Retto cat, not a new character. Image1 is original Retto identity/anatomy and proportion reference. Image2 is the earlier Retto school cat for eye/fur/hairclip identity ONLY; its boxy loose jacket and oversized collar are rejected. Image3 is Amu Hinamori's ORIGINAL SCHOOL UNIFORM AND ATTITUDE reference from Shugo Chara. Image4 is Hana skin MATERIAL QUALITY only, never its costume/proportions.
Redesign the wearable school outfit to fit Retto's real shoulders/chest and four feline legs: a short fitted black blazer with slim sleeves genuinely wrapping both FORELEGS, tailored shoulder seams and small believable elbow folds; modest white shirt collar sized to cat neck, a slightly loose deep red necktie over visible white shirt, a thin untucked white shirt hem visible at waist, short red-and-black tartan pleated skirt sitting around REAR HIPS behind forelegs. IMPORTANT iconic Amu RED ARMBAND wraps the VIEWER-RIGHT upper FORELEG sleeve (not a red breast pocket); tiny pale school crest on that armband, no words. Keep one small pink X hairclip on viewer-right ear. No human hair, no neck egg or magic costume in school mode. Remove the earlier red breast pocket, huge triangular collar and dangling empty sleeve/side panels. Every garment contour must wrap a real body volume, like a well-fitted custom garment.
Personality: quietly confident, cool and slightly cheeky Amu posture, chin just a little raised, attentive blue eyes, composed closed-mouth expression. NOT sleepy, gloomy, doll-like frozen, begging or a generic waving kitten. Neutral first frame before casually adjusting tie: both forepaws planted at natural shoulder width, rear paws support behind, weight settled with a tiny relaxed asymmetry. Exactly two front legs plus two rear legs; no duplicates. One original fluffy brown tail rests on viewer-right, not an inflated spherical ball.
Preserve original Retto's blue eyes, brown/cream-white ragdoll mask, rounded three-dimensional muzzle/nose, ear interiors and fluffy short fur; original cat's head/body proportions, not a giant flat-faced kitten. Same tactile short fur / matte felt cloth quality as Hana. Build full integrated cat+clothes as one coherent independent drawing, not a collage. Single isolated cat only, full body and all ears/tail in frame, genuinely transparent background, no floor/shadow/pet/effects/letters. Portrait framing like Image2 with transparent breathing room.

Use case: identity-preserve, anatomical proportion repair of this exact new Amu-school Retto anchor. Keep its face, eyes, ears, pink X clip, muzzle roundness, fur markings and face size EXACTLY the same. Keep the new fitted black school blazer, modest white collar, loose red tie, narrow untucked white hem, red plaid rear-hip skirt and red armband with small pale shield on VIEWER-RIGHT sleeve. These garment details are approved for this repair. The BODY BELOW THE CHIN is about 13 percent too tall/long compared with original seated Retto. Anatomically REDRAW the torso and forelegs about 13 percent SHORTER below the chin, with the rear haunches seated low and rear supporting feet tucked naturally behind the forefeet. Do not shrink, flatten, stretch, enlarge or retouch the head. Do NOT merely resize the whole picture. This is a physically more compact seated feline chassis, not a crouch, squat, long-legged standing cat or a human torso. Keep the front shoulders at real cat shoulder positions, fitted sleeve lengths shortening with the actual shorter forelegs, believable compact elbows and white cuffs above furry paws. No empty dangling sleeve or extra leg. Four legs total. Same cool composed attentive Amu attitude, chin slightly raised and both forepaws resting at natural shoulder width. One attached soft brown tail resting to viewer-right, not inflated; shorten only the overly elongated physical torso/forelegs. For registration intent: keep cheek width about 228 and seated eye-to-ground distance about 278 at a 448x640 cell. Every part is one integrated new anatomical drawing, NO pasted face/body parts. Single full-body isolated cat on actual transparent background; same framing and generous empty margins, no companion, props, particles, text or floor. Preserve tactile fur and fine matte wool cloth quality.

Use case: identity-preserve exact original Retto proportions. FIRST image is the current fitted-uniform costume candidate. SECOND image is the ORIGINAL Retto, the anatomy/size authority. Make ONE complete revised neutral full-body drawing with the first candidate's exact costume and face identity. Two anatomical refinements only: (1) match original Retto's compact seated neck-to-paw distance: the current torso/forelegs below chin are still about TWO percent too long; redraw them just slightly shorter with original low seated rear haunches, not standing long-legged. Target cheek width 228 and eye-to-support-ground distance about277 at 448x640; keep the head's exact dimensions and round three-dimensional muzzle. (2) The current brown tail is too inflated/wide. Match original Retto's narrower natural tail, reducing the current tail's width/bulk about25 percent while keeping its real hip attachment and fluffy texture; it must not become a huge spherical cushion. Keep tail on viewer-right and resting low as original. Do not narrow or flatten the head, inflate cheeks, change eyes, or shrink whole cat. All four legs counted once and grounded. Same attentive cool expression and pink X earclip.
Costume remains fitted black blazer with sleeves following real front legs, proper shoulder/elbow folds, small white collar/cuffs, red loose tie, thin white untucked shirt hem, short red-black plaid skirt ONLY around rear hips, and one red shield armband around VIEWER-RIGHT upper sleeve (not pocket). Same fine matte wool/felt + soft short fur quality. No jewelry, hat, human hair, effects or pet. Full integrated drawing only; no collage/patches. Single isolated full-body cat on true transparency, same framing and margins. Original cat proportions take priority over costume flourish.
